messages:
alex kim: heads up — seeing a spike of nodes in eu-west1 stuck at 'awaiting-bmc-reboot' during the firmware rollout. GPU pools reporting provisioning errors and capacity dropping fast.

maria gonzalez: on it. is this the new BMC image that toggles graceful-reboot? saw something similar in canary yesterday but thought it was isolated.

alex kim: yep same image tag: fw-bmc-2026-03-15. logs show nodes enter reboot, BMC reports a grace-window of 30s then goes to 'maintenance' state instead of coming back online. sample log: ```Mar 15 02:14:12 bmc[info]: power-cycle requested
Mar 15 02:14:23 bmc[warn]: graceful-reboot-window expired (30s) -> marking host maintenance
Mar 15 02:14:25 provisioning[error]: host unreachable: ping timeout```

cheng li: @maria can you pause the rollout for eu-west1? add a hold in the orchestrator and stop scheduling new reimages. I think the grace timer is too tight for our fleet.

maria gonzalez: paused. orchestrator hold applied for region eu-west1. new reimages blocked.

tim oncall: seeing immediate effect — pending reimages cleared from queue but capacity already down ~18% in eu-west1. starting cross-region routing to us-east to bail. tagging cost: will trigger burst GPUs in other regions.

alex kim: thanks tim. what's the plan to bring stuck hosts back without mass manual power cycles?

cheng li: quick mitigation: extend grace window on BMC agent to 90s and re-run a staged reboot on a small canary set (5 hosts) then sweep. I have a patch ready. need approval to push to eu-west canary.

maria gonzalez: +1 for staged patch. also add ipmi fallback to the runbook for hosts that remain maintenance. manual ipmitool power status and power cycle usually recovers. snippet: ```for host in $HOSTS; do ipmitool -I lanplus -H $host -U $USER -P $PASS chassis power status || ipmitool -I lanplus -H $host -U $USER -P $PASS chassis power cycle; done```

alex kim: can we automate a safe backoff — try soft reset, wait 60s, then ipmi hard cycle — to avoid thrashing?

cheng li: yep implement backoff in the rollout: soft-reset -> wait 60s -> ipmi hard cycle -> if still offline send to manual queue. will push patch to canary now.

sre-bot: [alert] eu-west1 provisioning.delta_rate: +120% (10m) — ingestion to central metrics.

maria gonzalez: canary patch deployed to 5 hosts at 1759876610. monitoring logs/health now. please don't schedule manual cycles on those 5.

tim oncall: observed canary behavior: two hosts recovered after extended window, no new maintenance flags. healthy. starting staged rollout in batches of 20.

alex kim: rolling in 20-host batches. ops note: during batch 2 one host failed ipmi auth — added to manual queue, SREs will remote in.

maria gonzalez: update for leadership: eu-west1 capacity impact ~18% at peak, estimated cost bump from cross-region burst ~+$2.4k/day if sustained. pausing further region rollouts until patch verified in eu-central too.

cheng li: opening a follow-up ticket to revert the 30s default in config and add a longer test in CI for slow BMC responses. ticket: INFRA-4321.

tim oncall: remediation complete for 95% of stuck hosts. manual queue down to 3 hosts. ramping down cross-region burst and rebalancing workloads back to eu-west1.

alex kim: final checklist before closing thread: 1) merge config default -> 90s 2) add ipmi-backoff into runbook 3) update rollout playbook to pause on >10% capacity drop 4) postmortem with cost impact.

maria gonzalez: will take 1,2,3. assigning postmortem to infra-ops. thanks all — good catch. :thumbsup:

cheng li: will create the PR for default change and link INFRA-4321.

sre-bot: [recover] eu-west1 provisioning.delta_rate normalized.

tim oncall: closing incident from oncall side, will follow up in INFRA-4321 and postmortem.
